# system.registerMlrsModule

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Register the mLRS Module.

```lua
system.registerMlrsModule()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function init()
  system.registerMlrsModule({configure = {name = "mLRS Configuration", create = create, wakeup = wakeup, event = event, close = close}})
end
```
